study type: Secondary analysis of a cross-sectional study
cohort: 29,647 women with prior caesarean section and no pregnancy complications in their current pregnancy who delivered a term singleton (live birth and stillbirth) at gestational age 37-41 weeks by pre-labour caesarean section, intra-partum caesarean section, or vaginal birth following spontaneous onset of labour
finding: Elective repeat caesarean section at 37 weeks was associated with higher odds of neonatal morbidity and mortality compared to expectant management, but risks at later gestational ages did not differ between groups.
